The Core Issue

The Sabbath — God’s Seal vs. Man’s Institution

The seventh-day Sabbath is the seal of the living God — the sign between God and His people forever. The first-day Sunday is the mark of Rome’s authority, exalted above the Word of God.

The Seventh-Day Sabbath

A Memorial of Creation — From Sundown Friday to Sundown Saturday

“Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy. Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work: but the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.”

— Exodus 20:8–11 (KJV) — The Fourth Commandment
The Seal of the Living God

The Sabbath: God’s Seal

A seal on a document proves it is real and official — showing the authority behind it with the official’s name, title, and territory. All three appear in the Fourth Commandment:

“the sabbath of the Lord thy God” — His NAME
“Lord made heaven and earth” — His TITLE (Creator)
“heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is” — His TERRITORY

At the end of time, those who keep God’s commandments — including the seventh-day Sabbath — show by their obedience that they are followers of Christ, not of the beast. Revelation calls this the “seal” on their foreheads.

“If you love me, you will keep my commandments.”

Jesus — John 14:15

“The fourth commandment is the only one of all the ten in which are found both the name and the title of the Lawgiver. It is the only one that shows by whose authority the law is given. Thus it contains the seal of God, affixed to His law as evidence of its authenticity and binding force.”

— Ellen G. White — Read Source →

“Sunday is our mark of authority… The church is above the Bible, and this transference of Sabbath observance is proof of that fact.”

— Catholic Record of London, Ontario, September 1, 1923

“Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

— Revelation 14:12 (KJV) — The Third Angel’s Message

Seal of God vs. Mark of the Beast

Two marks. Two kingdoms. Two destinies. Every soul in earth’s last generation will receive one or the other.

Seal of the Living God

The Seventh-Day Sabbath

  • Written by God’s own finger in stone — Exodus 31:18
  • The sign between God and His people forever — Ezekiel 20:12
  • Captain Bates’ 1849 tract: A Seal of the Living God
  • Reveals God as Creator — the memorial of creation
  • The 4th commandment — the heart of the Decalogue
  • Those sealed stand on Mt. Zion with the Lamb — Rev. 14:1
Mark of the Beast

Sunday — Man’s Institution

  • No Bible commandment — tradition of Rome alone
  • The Papacy claims Sunday as its mark of authority
  • Enforced by civil law — union of church and state
  • The image of the beast: U.S. enforcing Rome’s decree
  • The number 666 identifies the man of sin — Rev. 13:18
  • Those who receive it drink of God’s wrath — Rev. 14:9–10

Religious Liberty & the First Amendment

The United States Constitution guarantees the free exercise of religion and prohibits an establishment of religion. The Advent pioneers — especially Alonzo T. Jones — stood before Congress to oppose the Blair Bill’s Sunday law in 1888. The same crisis returns. The First Amendment was written precisely to prevent church-state union — the exact union the Second Beast of Revelation 13 will enforce.
